jobs.title: Director, Corporate Partnerships
jobs.description_text: As a Director of Corporate Partnerships, you'll identify and develop high-value partnerships with Fortune 500 companies that expand economic opportunity and innovation, remove barriers to education and meaningful work, strengthen communities, and bring people together around shared solutions. You'll work with senior business leaders to understand their priorities, identify opportunities that benefit both organizations, and build partnerships that create lasting value for companies and society. This isn't a traditional corporate partnerships role. You'll need the business acumen and entrepreneurial judgment to recognize opportunities others might miss, develop new approaches, and influence meaningful corporate decisions. You'll help companies put their people, resources, expertise, and influence behind solutions that expand opportunity and improve lives, demonstrating how business leadership can drive lasting change. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $150,000–$175,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus or variable compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. We believe incentives matter. Consistent with this approach, compensation may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

jobs.title: Email Content Strategist
jobs.description_text: As an Email Content Strategist on the Grassroots Editorial Team, you'll help Americans for Prosperity (AFP) develop compelling email campaigns that engage grassroots audiences, advances policy priorities, and inspire people to take action. In this role, you'll write and edit high-impact grassroots emails, including advocacy campaigns, newsletters, lifecycle communications, and event promotions. You'll also collaborate with our Growth, Marketing, and Lifecycle teams to develop content calendars and identify opportunities to improve audience engagement and campaign performance. This role requires 3+ years of professional writing experience in political communications, public policy, or grassroots advocacy, along with a strong understanding of email marketing and audience engagement. You should bring excellent writing and editing skills, sound editorial judgment, an analytical mindset, and an entrepreneurial approach to turning organizational priorities into action. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $75,000–$100,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. Consistent with this approach, base salary may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

jobs.description_text: The Role In the Indian pharmaceutical industry, majority of the top 30 organizations are revising their product portfolio to include complex generics, biologicals, biosimilars etc. They are also expanding into high-value therapy areas such as oncology, cardiology, immunology which contribute significantly in saving human lives. jobs.description_text: Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains About Flexport Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to. Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated. Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next. Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen.
